title: Acceptance criteria for one user story

title.description: Short imperative title, e.g. 'Flag requests older than 30 days as stale'.

criteria.description: Testable criteria. Name concrete identifiers (enum constants, methods, properties) so the implementation and the independently written tests agree.

affectedClasses.description: Simple names of the Java classes to change or create, e.g. 'WorkRequestValidator'.

outOfScope.description: Things this story deliberately does not do.
